title: Thank You, Deno
summary: This article discusses how Deno's competition with Node.js and Bun has driven innovation in the JavaScript runtime ecosystem, pushing forward better tooling, performance, and developer experience across all platforms.
problem_solved: Addresses how healthy competition between JavaScript runtimes accelerates ecosystem innovation and improves tooling for developers.
why_valuable: Highlights that Deno's entry into the runtime space has benefited the entire JavaScript community by forcing improvements and innovation across competing platforms.
